WRITING TEST 2

           OCCUPATIONAL ENGLISH TEST
           WRITING SUB-TEST: MEDICINE
           TIME ALLOWED:
           READING TIME: 5 MINUTES
           WRITING TIME: 40 MINUTES

           Read the case notes and complete the writing task which follows.


           Notes:
Patient: Lisa Hilton (Mrs.)
DOB: 11/09/1961
Ht: 160 cm
Wt:65 kg
BMI: 25.3(16/03/2018)

Social History: not working ,house wife
Married, 2 children (15 yrs & 5 yrs)
Nonsmoker
Nondrinker
Substance Intake: Nil
Allergies: penicillin drugs

FHx: Mother-Diabetes; hypertension;
Father: Hypertension
Maternal grandmother- unknown
Maternal grandfather-died of rectal cancer
Paternal grandmother-died of heart attack, 65
Paternal grandfather- 95 yrs, diabetes

PMHx: Childhood measles
1970 Jaundice
 
1990 RTA
2002 Food Poisoning
2013 Fibroid on uterus, Hysterectomy done
2016 viral fever
16/03/2018 aggravating pain and bilateral lower limb edema, particularly while walking. After
pregnancy, observed few areas of redness over varicosities occasionally.
Physical examination done.
Findings: multiple varicose veins, unhealthy skin, Morrissey’s cough impulse test done-positive.
Advised support stocking, plan for surgery in future if condition worsens.
Provisional Diagnosis: Varicose vein with superimposed acute thrombophlebitis.
20/03/2018
Subjective: complaints of severe pain in right leg-days;
Analgesics not helpful.
Objective: Highly distressed, Examination done; vital signs: T-38.2, P-100 bpm & B.P -140/80
Left leg is stable, no new change observed.
Rx Flucloxacillin (500mg) for 10 days, Panadeine Forte for pain.
Review after 48 hours or earlier depending on the severity of the condition.
23/03/2018 patient condition improved. no abnormal changes, redness on the infected leg
decreased.
Discussed with the patient& took her consent for surgical removal of varicose veins.

         Writing task:
Using the information in the case notes, write a letter of referral for further assessment and
management of this patient to the surgeon, Dr. Greg Boyle, Surgical Outpatient Clinic, Newton
Hospital.

         In your answer:

               Expand the relevant notes into complete sentences
               Do not use note form
               Use letter format
               The body of the letter should be approximately 180-200
               words.
   Relevant Case      Writing Test
       Notes               2
   Custom Sentence        Writing Test
        Styles                 2
